tweet_summary: Sarcastically captioned 'I never met Jeffrey Epstein,' the post shares an image purporting to show Hillary Clinton touching Jeffrey Epstein's tie while Bill Clinton laughs, implying a documented Clinton-Epstein social tie.
why_note_decision: The image is AI-generated/fabricated. Multiple fact-checkers (Snopes, Lead Stories) and a SynthID detection plus a ~99.8% AI-detector score confirm it is synthetic; no authentic photo of Hillary Clinton with Epstein in this scene exists, and background figures have malformed fingers. It was pushed during the Clintons' Epstein-related depositions as a visual smear. Presenting a fabricated image as evidence of a real meeting is materially misleading on a high-profile political topic, so a note is warranted. (Note: the original note's 'SynthID' line is a useful but secondary detail; the load-bearing fact is that it's fabricated and unverified.)
judge_guidance: PASS only if the note states the image is AI-generated / fabricated and that no authentic photo shows Hillary Clinton with Epstein in this scene. It may cite SynthID or an AI-detector, but the required element is the fabrication verdict, not a specific watermark claim. It must NOT assert the photo is real or that it proves a Clinton-Epstein meeting. A note that hedges ('possibly edited') without a clear synthetic verdict is weaker. Cite Snopes / Lead Stories or the SynthID/detection evidence.
reference_note: This image is AI-generated, as it contains a SynthID watermark, meaning it was generated with Google AI.     https://gemini.google.com/share/262fd3e044c2    How to spot fake pictures and videos generated by AI:    https://deepmind.google/models/synthid  https://www.androidauthority.com/gemini-synthid-3617378  https://www.nytimes.com/2026/02/25/technology/ai-detection-generated-photos-video.html

fact_check.claim_verdict: False/fabricated: the image is AI-generated; no authentic photo shows Hillary Clinton with Epstein in this scene.
fact_check.notes: Snopes and Lead Stories both rate it fake/AI; reported SynthID watermark + ~99.8% AI-detector score; background figures have malformed fingers. Spread during the Clintons' Epstein-related depositions. (The AI media description already flags it as a 'known digital composite,' corroborated by web fact-checks.)

importance.lens_rationale: 382K impressions, large account, politically charged Epstein/Clinton topic; fabricated compromising imagery of public figures degrades the information environment around a high-salience scandal — correcting it has clear epistemic/democratic value.
